Good questions

Before you get started.

Is Spooldesk open source?+

It is source-available under Business Source License 1.1, rather than an OSI open-source license. The current grant permits production use within its terms. Hosted or managed offerings to third parties need separate rights. The LICENSE file defines the change date and terms. Read the license ↗

Do I need to buy hosting from you?+

No. Run Spooldesk on a suitable computer, server or cloud account you control. Even a paid setup happens on your infrastructure. Its availability depends on that machine, its internet connection and how it is maintained.

Does it work without Telegram or AI?+

Yes. Choose the channels you need. Email and the website widget can work without Telegram. AI is optional, and external providers are billed separately.

Can I test it on another computer first?+

Yes. Install a clean instance with Docker and PostgreSQL on your own computer. No VPS or Spooldesk account is required for that test. The installation only stays available while that computer is running; internet-facing channels also need the appropriate public endpoints.

What happens if I stop paying for maintenance?+

Your self-hosted installation remains on your infrastructure under its license. The maintenance service ends under the agreed terms; you take over updates, backup checks and incident handling.

How does the AI use our company knowledge?+

Add company documents, published articles and team reply templates. Relevant knowledge and permitted conversation history guide the agent’s answers. You choose whether it may ask questions and continue a dialogue. It stops for human takeover; ticket changes by the workspace assistant require your confirmation. This uses reference context, not separate model training.
